candidates.name: Nevoid Basal Cell Carcinoma Syndrome
support_spans: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules located on the face and vulva
A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
Eight lesions underwent biopsy, showing buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
candidates.why: The combination of skin-colored papules, family history of similar lesions, and a specific genetic mutation in the SUFU gene supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome
